threshold.statistic: condition 1 of G-7 evaluated with and without the budget exclusion

measured.condition_tested: condition 1 of G-7: a compute-matched tensor network falls below cosine 0.8. It is the condition the exclusion rule could plausibly have manufactured, so it is the one tested here.
measured.interpretation: The exclusion rule removes 64.1% of L = 12 cells, and it removes exactly the cells where the classical reference is most strained: the single worst tensor network cosine in the whole sweep, 0.875797, belongs to a cell the rule excludes. Putting every excluded cell back therefore moves the worst case from 0.999981 to 0.875797, a large move, and still leaves zero cells below 0.80. The null does not rest on the exclusion rule. The tensor network would have to be a further 8.7% worse on its worst cell before condition 1 fired.
